**Is your feature request related to a research problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the research challenge, baseline to reproduce, or performance bottleneck.

**Proposed Solution**
A clear and concise description of the architectural or algorithmic change you propose. Include mathematical formulations or paper references if applicable.

**Alternatives Considered**
A description of any alternative solutions, baselines, or workarounds you've considered.

**Target Benchmarks & Hardware**
Which datasets or hardware platforms (MPS, CUDA, CPU) should this feature target?

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, code snippets, or literature citations here.
